svg.title: Ashton Long
svg.desc: An animated electron micrograph of brain tissue. Three neurons, labelled Fruit Fly, AnkiGPT and ScanAir, are traced into view, then slow signals travel along their branches. Ashton Long, Computer Science co-op, University of Guelph. Open to co-op. Contract developer at ScanAir. Based in Guelph, Ontario.
